## Activity

During March 2022, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 396 captures. Activity was recorded for the month as planned, with session lists operating apart from routine leave. The service continued to provide image capture and subsequent grading through the reporting period. The capture total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 396 captures, 20 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.1%. These images could not be used for grading and are included in the reported image-quality outcome. The result should be considered alongside the total capture activity for Harbour Eye Clinic during March 2022.

## Grading

Grading identified 78 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 17 days. This is the median interval reported for the month and describes the time between the image being captured and the grading outcome being recorded. Overall, the activity, image-quality and grading measures provide the operational summary for Harbour Eye Clinic in March 2022.
